Core Continental Growth Drivers & Market: Primarily concentrated in luxury passenger vehicles in South Africa, alongside foundational micro-pilots in North and East Africa.
First widespread commercial asset-financing programs scale up in East Africa; initial battery-swapping networks deploy.
The Ethiopia Shift: Ethiopia implements a world-first outright ban on internal combustion engine (ICE) passenger vehicle imports, forcing a structural migration to EVs.
The Assembly Boom: Localized production lines scale across regional hubs (e.g., South Africa's 2026 production rebates, Morocco's $5.6B battery factory, and Kenya/Uganda e-bike assembly).
